question: The downstream speed is 115 km/hr and the upstream speed is 23 km/hr. It takes a total of 25 hours to go to a place and come back. What is the total distance travelled by boat?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance travelled in a round trip = Average speed × Total time.

Average speed = (2 × SD × SU) ÷ (SD + SU)

⇒ Average speed = (2 × 115 × 23) ÷ (115 + 23) = 5290 ÷ 138 = 115 ÷ 3 km/hr

⇒ Total distance = (115 ÷ 3) × 25 = 2875 ÷ 3 km

⇒ Total distance = 958 1/3 km

**∴ The correct answer is 958 1/3 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Downstream speed (SD) = 115 km/hr

Upstream speed (SU) = 23 km/hr

Total time (T) = 25 hours

 
• One-way Distance = D Start Destination 
• 
 Downstream: 115 km/hr 
• 
 Upstream: 23 km/hr Total Time = 25 hours | Total Distance = 2D 

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

Let the one-way distance be D km.

⇒ Time taken downstream + Time taken upstream = Total time

⇒ D ÷ 115 + D ÷ 23 = 25

⇒ (D + 5D) ÷ 115 = 25

⇒ 6D = 25 × 115

⇒ D = 2875 ÷ 6 km

We need to find the total distance travelled (to and fro), which is 2D.

⇒ Total Distance = 2 × (2875 ÷ 6)

⇒ Total Distance = 2875 ÷ 3 km

⇒ Total Distance = 958 1/3 km

**∴ The correct answer is 958 1/3 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

If a boat covers a certain distance at a speed of x km/hr and the same distance at y km/hr, then the average speed during the whole journey is (2xy) ÷ (x + y) km/hr.

Speed of Boat in Still Water

If downstream speed is SD and upstream speed is SU, then the speed of the boat in still water is (SD + SU) ÷ 2.

Speed of Stream

If downstream speed is SD and upstream speed is SU, then the speed of the stream or current is (SD − SU) ÷ 2.
